description: This file defines the class `KmsMaterialsProviderV2`, which provides methods for encrypting and decrypting data keys using AWS KMS. It is part of the AWS SDK's Crypto namespace and implements the MaterialsProviderV2 interface for managing cryptographic materials, specifically tailored for use with version 2 encryption clients like S3EncryptionClientV2.

classes.name: KmsMaterialsProviderV2
classes.description: A class for managing encryption and decryption of data keys using AWS KMS, supporting version 2 of the materials provider interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the KmsClient and optional KMS key ID.

methods.name: getWrapAlgorithmName
methods.description: Returns the name of the wrap algorithm used ('kms+context').

methods.name: decryptCek
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted content encryption key (CEK) using AWS KMS.

methods.name: generateCek
methods.description: Generates a new data encryption key (DEK) using AWS KMS with specified key size and encryption context.
